description: Kick-off: ERP confirmed as Business Central (if it is SAP Business One, quotes are asked before the platform is bought)
Fixed scope per phase and a 15 % contingency approved by the CFO
Fabric Warehouse in West Europe with its supported dbt adapter, no preview features in production
Glossary signed by its owners; raw layer open to the data engineer only; retention periods and erasure procedure approved by the DPO
Internal data engineer in post (hired or trained) and paired with the consultant for the whole build
1-year Fabric reservation and annual Fivetran contract signed; Airbyte kept as back-up
Go/no-go for phase 1
Business Central link to Fabric live; the daily stock snapshot starts, because the ERP keeps only today's stock
Shopify and POS loaded by Fivetran every 15 minutes; POS in small batches with retries, freshness tests per store and a daily reconciliation with ERP sales totals
3 years of history (2024 to 2026) loaded once, reconciled with ERP finance, then frozen
Customer matching rules approved and data stewards named; match rate measured by a dbt test and reported every month
Inventory baseline starts: stock-outs and overstock counted every month from the snapshots
Sales reports live, with the last refresh time on every page; parallel run with the old reports starts
Old sales reports retired after two reconciled month-end closes (August and September)
A second person trained as back-up for the data engineer
Six-month inventory baseline (July to December) presented to the steering committee
Go/no-go for phase 2
Inventory build starts on 9 months of snapshots; Fabric capacity checked with the Capacity Metrics app (it stays at F2 unless the app shows it is too small)
Stock cover, sell-through, stock-out and overstock lists live; parallel run with the supply chain spreadsheets
First monthly comparison of stock-outs and overstock with the baseline
Go/no-go for phase 3; inventory result reviewed against the baseline
DPIA for customer segmentation started by the DPO
Klaviyo loading chosen: which event types Fivetran syncs, compared with Airbyte (free if self-hosted), because Klaviyo is the biggest Fivetran cost
DPIA approved: customer data can be loaded for segmentation
Klaviyo and Zendesk loaded every hour, web analytics and social media every day; consent flag carried from the source
Match-rate gate: at least 90 % of Klaviyo profiles with an order matched, and fewer than 200 pairs waiting for review
Customer and Marketing reports live; segments exclude people without consent
Erasure procedure tested end to end, from the source tools to Power BI
Go/no-go for phase 4; inventory result reviewed against the baseline; the consultant leaves after handing over
Last channel reports (support, web and social dashboards) retired
Run book complete; the steering committee becomes the data governance committee
Project closed after the run team has worked one whole phase without the consultant; inventory result reviewed against the baseline
